integrity: The result is a symbolic finite classification corroborated by exhaustive reproducible enumeration and an independent finite matching oracle; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results concern teams of four named Boolean variables, grouped into two two-bit tuples, with lax split and three specified clauses; no general-domain enumeration. title: Exact 292 minimal obstructions for a three-way Boolean dependence split
